title: Driver profile recognition and loading
summary: This topic centers on driver profiles being recognized, loaded, associated with keys or devices, or defaulting to guest mode, with most examples describing setup or troubleshooting rather than clear satisfaction or dissatisfaction.

negative.summary: The negative feedback describes keys not being recognized, which prevents the correct driver profile from loading.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so the sentiment evidence is limited.
